# TP Pure Nails

> Organic nail spa based in Austin, Texas. TP Pure Nails is a clean, relaxing South Lamar nail spa with organic pedicures, dip and gel that lasts, and a glass of wine or a mimosa on the house.

- Phone: (512) 383-8357
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Sunset Valley, Manchaca, Buda, Kyle
- Yelp rating: 4.3 from 178 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/tp-pure-nails/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/nail-salons/texas/tp-pure-nails/book.html

## Services
- Organic pedicures: Sea salt soak, organic scrub and mask, and a long massage.
- Gel manicures: Gel that lasts, with careful cuticle work.
- Dip powder: Dip manicures explained step by step, great for first-timers.
- Seasonal nail art: Holiday, fall and custom accent nails.

## About
TP Pure Nails is a non-toxic nail spa at 3401 South Lamar, with free garage parking. Tracy and her team, including April, Kiana and Bernice, do organic pedicures, gel, dip and seasonal nail art. Reviewers love the sea-salt organic pedicure, the complimentary drinks and happy hour, and gel that lasts a month. It's a favorite stop for couples and ClassPass regulars.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do you take walk-ins at TP Pure Nails?
  A: Yes, walk-ins are welcome. To skip the wait, call (512) 383-8357 or book online.
- Q: Where is TP Pure Nails?
  A: 3401 S Lamar Blvd, Ste 3133, Austin, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: What nail services do you offer?
  A: Manicures, pedicures, gel, dip powder, acrylic full sets and fills, nail art and waxing.
- Q: Can I bring a nail art idea?
  A: Yes. Bring a photo and your tech will match the shape, color and design.
- Q: What do clients say about Pure Nails?
  A: TP Pure Nails is rated 4.3 stars from 178 Yelp reviews. Clients mention organic pedicures, complimentary mimosas and gel that lasts a month.
